name: Kani (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kani city emblem in maroon: a stylised device of a ring and a diagonal stroke, like the numeral 7.
history: Municipal flag of Kani, a city in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 October 1964.

features.role: Kani city emblem — a stylised device of a ring and a diagonal stroke, like the numeral 7
